subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close/adopt the conflicting linked fork pull request or allow a new narrow replacement fix for the active Telegram approval runtime?
rationale: The bug shape is clear, but the issue is still linked to an open conflicting fork pull request with closing syntax, so automation should not queue a competing fix until maintainers choose that path.

options.title: Replace the fork PR
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork pull request and land a narrow active-runtime fix with Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt the fork branch
options.body: Have a maintainer repair the fork branch by removing obsolete handler and unrelated docs changes before review.

options.title: Wait for contributor rebase
options.body: Leave this issue blocked on the fork contributor to rebase, retarget, and provide proof.

recommendation.title: Replace the fork PR
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork pull request and land a narrow active-runtime fix with Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the active native approval lifecycle and is the strongest history signal for the final-action seam involved.
